d: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.

Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
During Your Tenure As An Associate In Audit & Assurance, You Will Demonstrate And Develop Your Capabilities In The Following Areas
Demonstrates an appreciation of the importance of addressing specific audit and risk advisory priorities in line with explicit stakeholder requirements.

Have knowledge of relevant accounting standards applicable to the entity and perform risk assessment procedures to provide a basis for the identification and assessments of the risks of material misstatement.
Delivery of high-quality audits via a number of enablers like Global Audit Imperatives, methodology, content, guidance, learning and other tools.
Formulate reasonable judgements and conclusion in order to deliver informative and timely outputs.

Compliance with auditing and accounting standards, relevant laws and regulations (including specific local laws and regulations), ethical standards, independence requirements and the audit firm's quality control procedures.

d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.
The Lobby Ambassador is responsible for creating a warm, welcoming, and personalized guest experience by being the primary point of contact within the hotel lobby.

The role focuses on proactively welcoming guests, assisting with enquiries, coordinating guest requests, maintaining the lobby atmosphere, and ensuring smooth communication between guests and hotel departments.
The Lobby Ambassador represents the Tivoli brand standards and ensures that every guest interaction reflects the hotel's commitment to luxury hospitality, genuine care, and personalized service.
Welcome guests warmly and professionally upon arrival and departure.
Proactively approach guests in the lobby and offer assistance.
Create a positive first impression through personalized and attentive service.
Assist guests with general enquiries about hotel facilities, restaurants, residences, and available services.
Recognize VIPs, repeat guests, and long-staying guests and ensure personalized attention.
Support guests who require assistance during check-in and check-out.
Maintain a visible presence in the lobby at all times.
Monitor lobby activities and ensure a smooth flow of guest movement.
Coordinate with Bell Attendants, Reception, Concierge, and other Front Office colleagues.
Ensure the lobby area is clean, organized, and welcoming.
Identify any service gaps or operational issues and report them immediately.
Assist guests with transportation arrangements and directions within the property.
Handle guest enquiries, comments, and complaints professionally.
Take ownership of guest requests and follow up until resolution.
Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely responses.
Escalate serious complaints or service recovery cases to the Front Office Management.
Maintain positive relationships with guests and encourage repeat visits.
Maintain excellent knowledge of hotel facilities, restaurants, operating hours, and promotions.
Be familiar with Tivoli LA VIE Muscat Hotel & Residences services and residential facilities.
Provide information about local attractions, shopping destinations, restaurants, and points of interest in Muscat.
Promote hotel outlets and services whenever appropriate.
Maintain effective communication with all operational departments.
Share relevant guest preferences and special requests with the concerned teams.
Participate in daily briefings and departmental meetings.
Record and communicate guest feedback and outstanding requests.
Ensure proper handover of pending guest matters between shifts.
Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in Front Office, Guest Relations, Concierge, or luxury hospitality is an advantage.
Fluency in English is essential; additional languages are an advantage.
Strong knowledge of hotel operations and guest service standards.
Professional appearance, positive attitude, and excellent grooming standards.
Positive guest feedback and satisfaction scores
Proactive interaction and assistance with guests
Timely follow-up and resolution of guest concerns
Effective recognition of VIPs and repeat guests
Knowledge of hotel facilities and services
Comply with all hotel policies, procedures, and departmental standards.
Follow health, safety, and security procedures.
Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the reporting manager.
